body.x: We have different scene at CES this year.

While CES had been in recession since 2008 economic crisis in US, the scale of the exhibition was expanded as they arranged featured zone in parking lot, which means they had more exhibiting companies.

However, we didn't see that many attendees coming to the show this year. Usually in the average year, Press Room was crowded with bunch of reporters across the world, and it would be really hard to find a seat in the room on opening day and second day as well. You have to wait for ages to take your lunch box standing in line. But it was NOT as those days.
AVING News made a 9th visit to the show with the most number of reporters from Korea. Thus now we seem to have obtained an eye for the trends, looking at some clues on the show floor.

From January 5th and 6th Press Day to the last day on 10th, we had some clues that Korean manufacturing companies would have a difficulty in 2014 especially for Samsung. Samsung is predicted to drop off, starting from this year.
From the early last year, 4K-TV was released in the US market and Full-HD(Smart LED) still remains as the main product in Television market.

Therefore, the Samsung television department has to get rid of all their stock of Full-HD TV and struggle to compete in price with Japan, China and more. Moreover, bigger sized TV incurs distribution cost, so that companies need to raise the ratio of local production. In other words, Samsung has to take several risks including quality issue on that background.

For smart phone, too, Samsung's new product probably will be launched at MWC in Barcelona or in some other places, yet they would not expect that much response from the market. So far, Samsung imitated and modified designs of Apple, adding some ideas such as enlarging display size or adding a pen. However, it was never regarded as a real 'First Mover' since we have been watching them at the global scene.
Those who only follow money would not take a risk to the adventurous challenge, because they can earn money by imitating other's product that become faster, cheaper and prettier.

Needless to say, that ability has to be acknowledged as 'competitiveness'. Samsung has exhibited that ability in Television industry in 2006 against SONY and in Smart phone industry in 2010 against 'Apple', which brought enormous amount of money. They will continue to do so.
AVING News has provided and analyzed information from a differentiated point of view for the last 10 years. Thus, we believe that Samsung should have utilized that information, too.
Since we keep records of Samsung, we would say Samsung cannot be more than 'Money Making Company'.

Samsung represents the current situation of Korea. Whatever happened to the process, whoever the leader is, 'Money' covers everything and makes the person winner and hero. That is Samsung and that is Korea in the 21st century.

The future looks grim for the Korean economy as we learned from ‘CES 2014’. While Samsung drops off, whole Korea industry will inevitably suffer from that, and we may have to share the responsibility.
Article by KIDAI KIM, translated by Miri Ahn
** Video taken with iPhone5, edited with iMovie. We focus on video news starting from 'CES 2014' as the starting point.
